title: Diagonal symmetrisation of tridiagonal Toeplitz matrices
summary: We develop a self-contained framework for real tridiagonal Toeplitz matrices $A_n(a,b,c)$ (diagonal $b$, subdiagonal $a$, superdiagonal $c$) in the symmetrisable regime $ac>0$. A diagonal similarity transforms $A_n(a,b,c)$ into a symmetric Toeplitz matrix, yielding explicit eigenpairs, a Chebyshev determinant/characteristic polynomial formula, and a closed Green kernel for the inverse. As an application we give sharp extremal eigenvalue and conditioning formulae in the natural weighted Hilbert space induced by this similarity.
